scope: The maintained case qualifies a three-stage HBT transimpedance core with active emitter-follower feedback from 1 MHz through 100 MHz. The extraction boundary includes candidate-derived HBT geometry and distributed interconnect R/C; no RF transmission-line or EM result is implied.

source_boundary.source_tap: XRSUB VSS SUBSTRATE ptap1 A=4e-12 P=8e-6 R=81.6666667

native_extraction.klayout: Strict KLayout LVS retains the physical ptap1 card, all four-terminal HBT bulk nodes, and the declared Nx values.
native_extraction.magic: Magic supplies distributed interconnect resistance and capacitance. Its compact-device substrate boundary is reconciled only through the reviewed HBT merge; no internal Magic node name is used by the simulator deck.
native_extraction.approved_boundary: The extractor may reconcile the PDK-approved internal HBT substrate boundary when matching KLayout devices to Magic cards. The finite source tap remains an explicit model element and is not replaced by a simulator global gnd alias.

calibration.method: Run the same source testbench, pinned typical models, temperature and three input-current points after changing only XRSUB from its finite 81.6666667 ohm value to a 1e-6 ohm ideal rail connection.

linearity.method: Use the independently exported VSENSE current and RFOUT voltage at every dense DC point; compare each output to the straight line through the two endpoint samples and normalize by endpoint output span.

limitations: This case does not claim 97 GHz bandwidth, RF matching, noise figure, S-parameters, EM accuracy, PVT or mismatch performance.
The declared linearity range is the measured nominal headroom window and is not a compression-point claim outside that window.
